car to kitchen without the hall
2 windows, N and E: the one warning

note: Fan art: an original drawing of a fictional house as documented by fans; no marks or character names appear. A bay is not an element here — it is a wall that leaves the line and comes back, which is why both front rooms are `room polygon` and their areas are exact. The Rumpus Room is landlocked behind the garage, so its two windows face N and E and none faces the equator side: the one thing `arch lint` says about this house, and it is true. 9 rooms, 143.22 m², 92 lines.
